# ListRow

The list row.

`LL.ListRow` · Components · Lists & labels

## Use

```jsx
<LL.ListRow title={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.ListRow" title="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ListRowProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` | The name, in name-row (Marcellus 17px), in its rarity colour when `rarity` is set. |
| `rarity` | `'Common' \| 'Uncommon' \| 'Rare' \| 'Epic' \| 'Unique' \| 'Legendary' \| 'Legacy'` | Edges the thumbnail, colours the name and adds the rarity code after it. |
| `icon` | `"overview" \| "inventory" \| "essences" \| "combat-styles" \| "achievements" \| "soulstones" \| "world-map" \| "legacy-ascension" \| "quest-journal" \| "prophecies" \| "guild" \| "colosseum" \| "cinder-bazaar" \| "leaderboard" \| "settings" \| "nobility" \| string` | Thumbnail: an icon, an image URL, or any node. |
| `meta` | `React.ReactNode` | caption: type, level, guild rank. Beside the name; on its own line in comfortable. |
| `tags` | `React.ReactNode` | Tags after the name ("Equipped"). |
| `quantity` | `number` | Stack size, shown as ×3. |
| `value` | `React.ReactNode` | A formatted number, right-aligned; a unit after it is set muted. null shows "—". |
| `live` | `boolean` | The value changes by itself (a refreshed Bazaar price, a roster's status): each change takes the live-update mark, a `changed` wash held for duration-reveal … |
| `trailing` | `React.ReactNode` | An action or a status at the end: a sm Button, Presence. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | Selection is an ink bar and the raised wash — a shape, right in item contexts. |
| `muted` | `boolean` |  |
| `onClick` | `() => void` | Makes the name a button whose hit area covers the row; trailing actions stay separately clickable. |
| `density` | `'comfortable' \| 'standard' \| 'compact'` |  |
